rows.notes: The study is a literature review with a meta-analysis of 128 paired observations from 30 published studies; it reports no own experiment, survey or model runs, so Q1 is 'no'. Its statements on drip irrigation and salt leaching (Section 2.2.1) are drawn from cited work (e.g., Hanson et al. on wetting patterns around emitters yielding higher leaching fraction; Marchand and Abd El Hadi on drip preventing salt leaching to groundwater), not from the authors' own data. Even the meta-analysis does not treat drip irrigation as a separate SICS category (irrigation entries are conjunctive use, deficit irrigation, furrow systems).

notes: Document is a review/meta-analysis (Agronomy 2019, 9, 295); full text appears complete though some pages have duplicated/overlapping OCR text. No primary data on drip irrigation and salt leaching are reported.
